revised_claims.old_text: A sole proprietor retains direct control but cannot raise ownership finance by issuing company shares.
revised_claims.new_text: A sole proprietor retains direct control but cannot raise ownership finance by issuing company shares. Personal responsibility for business obligations is commonly called unlimited liability; the applicable rules determine enforcement.

revised_claims.old_text: A central bank performs central monetary functions such as monetary policy and oversight of the banking system.
revised_claims.new_text: A central bank issues currency, acts as banker to government and commercial banks, may provide conditional lender-of-last-resort liquidity, manages official foreign reserves and conducts monetary policy under its institutional framework.

revised_claims.old_text: A supply contraction with demand unchanged raises equilibrium price and reduces equilibrium quantity in the stated simple market model.
revised_claims.new_text: A decrease in supply (a leftward shift) with demand unchanged raises equilibrium price and reduces equilibrium quantity in the stated simple market model.
